findings.claim: San Anselmo qualifies as an owner-confirmed construction/current-solar example; public emergency readiness remains unverified. It was not selected as an optimal East Bay location.

Hayward announced routine library-hour reductions for municipal budget savings effective January 1 2026. Current schedule closes both branches Sunday/Monday; ordinary meetings must be within library hours and reserved at least 30 days ahead.

findings.claim: A library expected to absorb heat/communications demand can lose staffed opening capacity under the same broader fiscal stress affecting other services; ownership and building capital do not establish usable public reserve.
findings.confirm: Published or observed service gap under heat/outage coincident with staffing limits
findings.falsify: Funded and successfully exercised activation at appropriate hours, with sufficient alternative capacity
findings.threshold: Reduced hours overlap actual need and alternative sites cannot absorb demand
